claims.assertion: Yazhi says starships can map locations as a numeric frequency gradient, but that model cannot capture non-linear conscious perception.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She treats the gradient as a navigation tool.

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes individual identity as remembered ideas and attachments within the one Source, without fixed boundaries between people.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She uses “soul” as a simplified label.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says shared reality is partial agreements; individual consciousness filters can make people perceive different aspects of other worlds.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She rejects fixed frequency rankings for direct perception.
